name: Himekawa Mami
source:
The heroine of this work. She is a senior employee in the same sales department as the main character, and is also older than him.

She has an aloof attitude and behavior, but she is the most skilled person in the company when it comes to work. In contrast to the protagonist, who is a dropout, she is already being called a candidate for the next section chief.

For some reason, she has taken a liking to the main character since he joined the company, and calls him “Kouhai-kun” in a friendly manner. However, the protagonist, who is constantly teased and played with, is half resigned to the fact that he may be being watched.

In fact, she is a genuine S-lover and sees through the protagonist's M nature. She is secretly aiming to eat the virgin's dick if the timing is right. 

As a side note, she's the elder sister of [url=/c24056]Himekawa Ami[/url] and the eldest of the three Himekawa sisters.

[From [url=http://rootnuko.jp/products/tenioha_mami/]official site[/url]]
